facts.statement: Free Realms celebrated its 4th birthday on April 29 with in-game dancing and socializing hosted by the Ambassadors.
facts.quote: It's our 4th Birthday, and we want to celebrate with you!

article_summaries.title: Happy 4th Birthday, Free Realms!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official news post announcing Free Realms' 4th birthday on April 29 (2013). Players were invited to join the Ambassadors for dancing and socializing at the Birthday Bash area in Sanctuary. The post is brief and gives no rewards or schedule beyond that day.
